role: 美术方向总览板，精确固定坐标以 B01.json 和布局图为准
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one polished game environment concept contact sheet for B01 SUNLIT RUINS. Create a high-resolution 3840 x 2160 landscape board if available.
Input image 1: reference only for artistic style, 2.5D camera angle, sunlit stone, bright hand-painted fantasy, material depth and color quality. DO NOT copy its HUD, text, character portrait, rusty winch or crates.
Primary request: EXACTLY a four-column by two-row contact sheet, eight equal independent framed panels, thin cream parchment gutters. Seven panels are SEPARATE DISTINCT playable room environment illustrations, NOT one big map cut into tiles. The eighth panel is a small prop showcase. Tiny dark-purple ID label only at the upper-left of each panel. Row one labels and order: L01, L02, L03, L04. Row two: L05, L06, BO01, PROPS. No other writing, HUD, menus, arrows, decorative titles or watermark.
Style: bright, beautiful hand-painted cartoon fantasy game environment, elevated three-quarter oblique near-isometric camera, genuine coherent 2.5D depth, clean readable outlines, warm morning sunlight from upper left, ivory sandstone with subtle low-contrast paving and very sparing cracks, brass gilded mechanical garden technology, turquoise magic crystal, fresh sage-green foliage, cream flowers. Fresh cheerful ancient Mediterranean magical garden ruins mixed with whimsical magical steam constructs. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT gloomy or gritty. Maintain the same camera, scale, palette and shadow direction across all seven rooms.
Space: show a complete usable small room within each panel, broad continuous dry walkable stone floor, most of the central area open for combat, handcrafted meaningful perimeter prop clusters, clear entrance and exit. Props low or transparent framed. At most a few short decorative pillars near the outer perimeter. Small turquoise channels are permitted only OUTSIDE the playable perimeter. Absolutely no square ponds, rectangular water pits, trenches across routes, dark voids, tall flat walls, stretched vertical floor texture, grid repeats, rusty old industrial winches, piles of identical crates. Central ornament is flat floor inlay or a low delicate open-frame object, not a collision wall. Each room is recognizable from its silhouette and environmental storytelling.
Panel L01, SUN CLOCK GATE COURT: diagonal route from southwest entry to northeast exit and an open northern loop; central low FLAT round ivory and brass sun-clock flower inlaid in the floor with petal-shaped pointer; welcoming bell-tree branches, clockwork flowers with brass stems and ceramic petals, small curved gardener's bench, crystal seed cradles, two ivy-crowned short pillars on the far perimeter. A few tiny bronze insect-like construct patrol guards show scale. This is an inhabited bright entrance garden.
Panel L02, FLOATING CRYSTAL ARCH: west to east entrance/exit, two BROAD DRY paths merging in the middle, warm CONTINUOUS dry stone floor throughout; delicate arch made of three floating turquoise crystals over two slim ivory feet at center. Perimeter mini glass domed seedling greenhouses, shallow decorative channel outside the northern edge, brass lens tripods and crystal lotus plants. NO actual gap or pool under the crystal arch. It should look distinct from L01.
Panel L03, RUNE GALLERY: northwest entry, southeast exit with an S-shaped route hinted by floor patterns, three interlocking round rune INLAYS flush with the continuous floor. One tiny brass sun-and-moon ORRERY on the northern perimeter, spring and winter clockwork flower clusters, transparent bell branches, small seasonal seed dome. The rune rings are light subtle cyan and brass, no enclosing walls and no raised platform. A squat shield construct plus wheel-foot mechanical hound can appear small at the room edge.
Panel L04, PRISM INSTRUMENT COURT: west-middle entry to northeast exit with broad northern zigzag and southern bypass; a central open brass SUN AND MOON ORRERY, three low leaf-shaped LIGHT-SCALES with round, triangular and diamond crystals on distinct edges of the route. Two small round copper garden furnaces on opposite FAR outer edges, puffing only two tiny white cloud puffs. Cool-dew ceramic amphorae, thin light lenses and gardener's bench. This is a magical outdoor garden laboratory, not a factory.
Panel L05, SUNLIT LIFT GARDEN: entrance northwest and exit northeast, broad U-shaped southward route and unobstructed central spine. Central low flower-bud CERAMIC LIFT POD, ivory petals, brass joints, cyan spring energy. Additional tiny seed pods along OUTER perimeter, hanging bell branches, waiting sunflower constructs, one little glass seedling dome and delicate dew valve. Show whimsical lift imagery by low flower pods rather than a towering platform. NO interior cliff, elevated square platform or high wall.
Panel L06, CORE CALIBRATION GARDEN: southwest entry to northeast exit and Z-like alternating north/south flow; central FLAT three-petal SUN CALIBRATION INLAY with small turquoise core. Three distinct edge clusters: condensation with white dew amphora and transparent droplet valve, warmth with little round petal-mouth copper furnace, waste-light with crystal lens and clockwork flower. Sparse subtle turquoise energy lines merge at the center. Some slightly tougher small construct guards stand on separate open floor zones.
Panel BO01, SOLAR COLOSSUS COURT: south entry and north exit, largest open circular dry-floor arena, three low turquoise energy terminals separated around the arena, FLAT petal-shaped solar floor inlay behind the boss. Center: a unique noble DAYLIGHT MECHANICAL COLOSSUS, broad ivory ceramic shoulders, warm brass joints, turquoise sun-shaped chest crystal, friendly-but-formidable cartoon fantasy guardian, large enough to read while leaving room to dodge. Open outer loop, only three short ivory cover columns at the far perimeter, small glass revival greenhouses, celebration bell trees and clockwork blossoms. NO obstruction ring. Boss appears only in this panel.
Panel PROPS: four beautiful isolated larger prop drawings on cream background, same camera and sunlight: (1) brass clockwork flower with white ceramic petals and cyan gem center, (2) rounded glass crystal-sprout miniature greenhouse, (3) delicate brass sun-and-moon orrery, (4) petal-mouthed copper garden furnace with small cloud puffs. Draw believable volume and exquisite whimsical details, no labels.
Final constraints: exactly eight equally sized panels, seven DIFFERENT independent room concepts plus a prop panel. These are art direction illustrations; readable handcrafted space and visual identity are more important than diagram labels. Keep the generous open playable center and varied thematic prop arrangements of each room.
